name: Vercel Queues
summary: Vercel Queues is a managed message queue on Vercel. Producers publish to durable topics, and each subscribed consumer group receives messages with retries, visibility timeouts and at-least-once delivery, either pushed to a Vercel Function or pulled by your own workers. It is the lower-level primitive underneath Vercel Workflows.
facts: Push to Vercel Functions or poll from anywhere
Per API operation, regional; 1M ops included on Hobby
goodFor: Deferring background work from Vercel Functions
Redelivering agent turns after a crash
